verdict.rationale: three.js is a client-side JavaScript library with no HTTP service, but a machine-readable description of its API is still a fair ask for a library's ecosystem, so the axis applies. Probes found no OpenAPI or swagger file at any candidate path. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are prose documentation rather than a structured API spec. The @types/three typings are community-maintained, have mismatched signatures, and are not maintained by the project's creator.
